requirements: Live recovery requires original state connected and genuine current generation under active original owner; HTTP/setup/task/cache success is insufficient.
Initial/bootstrap/setup-ready/mount-after-ready/reset and generation/state loss reconcile readonly information and clear stale decisions/preview/grant.
Recovery never auto-confirms policy, plans/grants/creates/executes, duplicates/replays a task or fabricates worker/result.
needs_policy preserves original explicit consent; future decisions require freshest source/task/auth/permission/policy/expiry facts.
Pending readonly responses cannot restore stale state after loss/replacement/disposal, or overwrite newer current responses.
Failed/offline state truthful and normally readonly rereadable, without reload/disabled-control/auth bypass.
Repeated resets/refreshes coalesce or remain finite/read-only; subscription cleanup permits no late publications.
